title: Code and data for: Maritime exposure and latitude control different components of daily solar irradiance predictability across Brazil
description:
Python pipeline, NASA POWER daily data (2013–2023, eleven Brazilian state capitals) and result tables supporting the article submitted to Theoretical and Applied Climatology. A single notebook reproduces all tables and figures: six regression models (RF, GBT, SVM, ANN, MARS, CART), walk-forward validation (test years 2018–2023), climatology and Hargreaves–Samani references, and the seasonal–synoptic decomposition of explained variance.

Funding: National Council for Scientific and Technological Development (CNPq), Brazil, Grant 401718/2023-9 (CNPq/MCTI Call No. 10/2023, Category A, Emerging Groups). Data: NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project.
